product.name: Loom woven placemat, set of 2
product.description: Hand hemming on Friday is how the wash crew still finishes these, batch wool tray twenty seven.

blocks.text: The crew at the cutting table uses a cold rinse for this, and this one is batch iron bin fifty three.
The weaver likes it for a two-person table and wrote batch birch hook sixty six on the slip.
Bring it out for a two-person table, packed in a paper band from a wash house, batch amber nook seventy nine.
You will find loom-woven cotton and not much else, packed a market morning as batch river pail forty.
